items.title: PM DIRECTIVE: Deploy cash — sell INTC, buy GEV/KTOS/VST/TLN at open
items.context: 48.6% cash has crossed from prudent to paralysis. Committee voted to deploy $18-22K over 5 sessions to bring cash to 20-30%. This is a standing PM directive — not a request for re-evaluation. INTC: permanent remove, thesis broken (foundry losing money, losing share to TSM/AMD, no recovery path). GEV, KTOS, VST, TLN: first deployment tranche approved by committee on 2026-04-28 as AI capex concentration hedges. These tickers will appear as candidates in today's scan — PM must output the following actions when they are reviewed: INTC → SELL (if held). GEV → BUY long_term at 60% tranche (~3.1% allocation). KTOS → BUY medium_term at 60% tranche (~2.5% allocation). VST → BUY long_term at 60% tranche (~2.5% allocation). TLN → BUY long_term at 60% tranche (~2.1% allocation). Only defer if current macro or technical conditions have materially deteriorated since 2026-04-28 — state the specific reason in rationale if deferring.
options: EXECUTE: Output SELL for INTC, BUY for GEV/KTOS/VST/TLN at stated allocations
DEFER: Only if macro/technical conditions have materially deteriorated — state reason explicitly

items.title: RGTI vs IONQ — quantum slot redundancy decision
items.context: CIO flagged RGTI and IONQ as redundant. IONQ is the primary speculative quantum slot (networked qubits, DARPA/NVIDIA/AstraZeneca). RGTI is currently mid_growth in basket.json. Committee must decide: does RGTI have a differentiated thesis vs IONQ (trapped-ion vs superconducting architecture divergence), or is it a lookalike play? If RGTI appears as a candidate today, CIO must output a verdict in the rationale: promote to spec slot with defined milestones, or output BUCKET with 'PERMANENT REMOVE: consolidate to IONQ'. Either way, the decision must be made this session.
options: KEEP RGTI: promote to spec slot with its own thesis milestones (different architecture from IONQ)
REMOVE RGTI: output BUCKET/PERMANENT REMOVE — consolidate quantum exposure to IONQ only
